subject: Vendor onboarding: PO fields, GL-code mapping & invoice cadence for annual commitment
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@solsticeinc.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding & PO requirements for Redwood annual commitment

Hi Logan,

Thanks again — Solstice is moving to finalize the annual commitment for your platform. Procurement needs a quick checklist so we can get a PO issued from our side. Can you confirm the following for Redwood invoices?

- Required PO fields (PO number formatting, master PO vs. per-invoice PO)
- Net terms you are willing to accept (standard is Net30 / Net45 / Net60)
- Invoice cadence (monthly consolidated vs. per-invoice) and whether you support cost_center/GL fields on the invoice
- Any mandatory attachments for onboarding (W-9, SSAE evidence, other vendor docs)

We typically run a monthly AP cycle and prefer consolidated invoices, but I need to confirm with our ERP team. If you can send a recommended template/format and any notes about discounts for prepay or early payment, that'll speed us up.

Attached our vendor intake packet so you can see internal mappings we use.

Thanks — Maria
Maria Lopez
Senior Procurement Manager
Solstice Inc.
Attachment: VendorOnboardingPacket.pdf (pdf, 320KB)
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@solsticeinc.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding & PO requirements for Redwood annual commitment

Hi Maria — thanks for the packet and the clear list. Looping in Vanessa from Finance and Ben (your AE) to move this to a quick decision. See answers below and a couple of options we can take depending on your AP constraints.

1) PO fields
- Preferred: reference a Master PO (e.g., MP-<Solstice>-2026) on each invoice line and include the transaction-level PO (if you require a separate PO per invoice we can accept that too).
- Required fields we can support: PO number, cost_center, project_code, and a brief description field for GL mapping.

2) Net terms
- Standard for new enterprise customers is Net30.
- We can offer Net45 on a case-by-case basis for customers with established payment history.
- Net60 is atypical for first-year commitments but possible with Finance approval (will need a short form).

3) Invoice cadence and format
- We support monthly consolidated invoices (preferred) with line-item detail (token usage, model, unit price, and cost_center column).
- If your system requires an invoice per PO, we can emit per-invoice files but recommend consolidated monthly to minimize AP overhead.

4) Attachments
- We typically require a completed W-9 for US entities and can provide SSAE/SOC evidence on request.
- I'll attach our standard W-9 for your intake.

Discounts / early pay
- We have a program: 3% discount on invoices paid within 15 days (applies to invoiced amount excluding taxes).
- For prepayment or quarterly prepay commitments, we can discuss a tiered credit (up to 5%) but that requires changes to invoicing flow.

Next steps
- Vanessa: can you confirm Net60 approval path?
- Maria: if you can send a sample PO (format you will issue) and your ERP cost_center mapping, we will produce a sample invoice for your AP team to validate.

— Logan
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0138
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@solsticeinc.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 10:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding & PO requirements for Redwood annual commitment

Logan — appreciate the quick response. A few clarifications from Procurement after reviewing with ERP: 

- Our standard is Net60 for third-party SaaS vendors for the first year. We can consider Net45 only after successful invoice reconciliation for Q4.
- We must attach a PO to each invoice (our AP team wants an explicit PO number per invoice for automated matching). A Master PO with a transaction reference is acceptable if the individual invoice includes the transaction reference.
- Invoice must include a cost_center column (we maintain a CSV workflow) and the GL account code.
- We cannot prepay or issue early-payment credits as a policy except for approved pilot vendors — we can escalate but timeline is tight.

I attached a blank PO template and an example of how our ERP expects cost_center/GL columns (PO_Template.csv).

If Redwood can deliver monthly consolidated invoices that include a per-line cost_center and a transaction reference (matching our PO), and Finance approves Net60 in the intake form, we can proceed to generate the first PO next week.

Regards,
Maria 
Attachment: PO_Template.csv (csv, 2KB)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@solsticeinc.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 15:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding & PO requirements for Redwood annual commitment

Hi Maria — thanks for the clear constraints and the template. Vanessa and I reviewed; here's a practical path to get this live next week without blocking your AP cadence.

Proposal (compromise to match your policy + Redwood controls):
- Invoice cadence: monthly consolidated invoices (one file per month) that contain per-line transaction references and a cost_center column to support your CSV import. Each line will include: transaction_ref, usage_date, model, units, unit_price, cost_center, GL_code.
- PO handling: we will accept a Master PO number on the invoice header and include a transaction_ref column that maps to your per-invoice PO. This satisfies automated matching while keeping our billing coherent.
- Net terms: Redwood standard is Net30. We will provisionally accept Net60 for the first year pending a signed intake form and an AP escalation approval from Vanessa. Vanessa — can you confirm the intake form and escalation by EOD?
- Early-pay/discount: understood — we won't count on early-pay credits. If Solstice gets approval to pilot early-pay, we can offer 3% discount (subject to contract language).

Action items to finalize:
1) Maria: please send a sample completed PO (PurchaseOrder_Redwood_2026Q4.pdf) using your template so we can validate the mapping.
2) Logan: produce a sample invoice file (CSV + PDF) that mirrors Solstice's CSV columns and return to Maria for ERP validation.
3) Vanessa: confirm Net60 provisional approval path and any finance forms required.

If all good, Ben will push a one-time SOW amendment with the billing appendix that captures the PO/GL mapping and Net60 provisional terms. We aim to close onboarding this week.

Best — Ben
Ben Carter
